name: Steel-Cut Plain Oatmeal with Pure Brown Sugar
whyItWorks: Warm water-cooked oatmeal provides soluble beta-glucan fiber, which forms a gentle gel in the GI tract that regulates bowel movements without mechanical scraping. Sweetened lightly with pure brown sugar.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Prepare using hot water or lactose-free almond milk. Add a small spoonful of brown sugar. Skip raw walnuts, almonds, and dried cranberries if avoiding seeds and roughage.
